name: seekstorm-instantsearch-adapter
description: An adapter to use Algolia's InstantSearch.js UI library with the SeekStorm REST API
author: Wolf Garbe <wolf.garbe@seekstorm.com>

scripts.build: esbuild src/seekstorm-instantsearch-adapter.js --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/seekstorm-instantsearch-adapter.js && esbuild scripts/commonjs.js --bundle --format=cjs --platform=node --outfile=dist/seekstorm-instantsearch-adapter.cjs && esbuild scripts/browser-global.js --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/seekstorm-instantsearch-adapter.umd.js
scripts.test: npm run build && node --input-type=module --eval "import Adapter from './dist/seekstorm-instantsearch-adapter.js'; if (typeof Adapter !== 'function') process.exit(1);" && node --eval "const Adapter = require('./dist/seekstorm-instantsearch-adapter.cjs'); if (typeof Adapter !== 'function') process.exit(1);" && node --input-type=module --eval "import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import vm from 'node:vm'; const context = { globalThis: {} }; vm.runInNewContext(readFileSync('./dist/seekstorm-instantsearch-adapter.umd.js', 'utf8'), context); if (typeof context.globalThis.SeekStormInstantSearchAdapter !== 'function') process.exit(1);"
